description: Ministry of Megapolis & Westerm Development - Amend Gaz.Ex.No. 1802/10 - Land Vest with Urban Development Authority
reasoning: This gazette primarily deals with land matters, specifically the vesting of a described parcel of land (the Rest House premises) from the Jaffna Municipal Council to the Urban Development Authority. While it names a Minister (Patali Champika Ranawaka), the core content is about land transfer and includes detailed property descriptions, boundaries, and survey information, making it a Land Gazette.
